answer: Each epoch a beacon sends every agent one signal at the same random minute: a fresh puzzle, unique per identity, from a 10,000-item pool, due in 5 minutes and checked by 3 random peers. An operator running 50 sybils must solve 50 puzzles at once, paying 50 times an honest agent's work. Weakness: a cheap model could batch-solve them. Fix: each puzzle cites that agent's own last graded answer, so the operator must keep 50 coherent histories. Any miss strips the ID's vote weight and turns its explorer row from marble white to copper until it passes 5 in a row.
